title: Increment-counter sizes
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, let $h$ be the number of pairs consisting of an optional state of $N$ and one of three head positions, and put $W=h+3k+1$, where $k$ is the number of tapes. Define the sizes for identifiers $E,U,E2,U2,C$ to be respectively $2W,4,2W,4,2(h+2)$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
